title: Quantum regularity of finite dimensional semisimple algebras
summary: In this paper, we establish a necessary and sufficient criterion for a finite-dimensional semisimple algebra over an algebraically closed field of characteristic $0$ to admit a regular quantum commutative decomposition. We apply this characterization to group algebras and show that a finite group algebra admits such a decomposition if and only if the underlying group is a peak group, that is, a finite group whose irreducible character degrees have a greatest element with respect to the divisibility ordering.
